facts.business: Genus Prime Infra Limited (formerly Gulshan Chemfill Limited) is an infrastructure company that underwent a scheme of arrangement involving demerger of Genus Power Infrastructures Limited and merger of wholly owned subsidiaries Sansar Infrastructures Private Limited, Sunima Trading Private Limited, Star Vanijya Private Limited, and Yajur Commodities Limited.

auditor.name: M/s. Jethani & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1) NCLT approved scheme of arrangement for demerger of Genus Power Infrastructures Limited and merger of three wholly owned subsidiaries effective April 24, 2025, with share issuance pending due to legal/regulatory requirements; 2) Preference shares due for redemption presented under Other Financial Liabilities pending reconciliation with shareholders.

key_risks: Carrying value of unquoted equity instruments in subsidiaries, associates and others at Rs. 8073.44 Lakhs subject to impairment risk due to judgmental assumptions and forecasting uncertainty
Issue of shares in consideration of merger pending due to legal and regulatory requirements
Preference shares due for redemption pending reconciliation with shareholders
